title: Launch an online store with AI

questions.question: Do I need to know how to code to build an online store with Hostinger?
questions.answer: No. Describe what you sell and AI generates product titles, descriptions and images, then you customize every detail with the drag-and-drop editor. AI can do more of the technical work for you or guide you through it, so you get more done without technical expertise.

questions.question: What does it cost to sell online with Hostinger?
questions.answer: Plans start from $2.49/mo, paid upfront, with a free domain for 1 year included with yearly plans. You sell with 0% transaction fees and accept 100+ payment methods with no extra charges, so you keep more of what you earn.

questions.question: Can I move my existing store to Hostinger?
questions.answer: Yes. Tell Hostinger Agent you want to move your site to Hostinger and get help every step of the way. Hostinger Agent is included with every plan to migrate, fix, edit and manage your site through chat, and solves 85% of issues without a human.

questions.question: Will my store show up in Google and AI search?
questions.answer: Your content is automatically optimized for Google Search and AI search. You can also connect Google Ads, Meta Pixel and Google Analytics to track traffic, and create ready-to-send email campaigns with Hostinger Reach.
